_comment: Curated competitor/partner watchlist for the Competitive & Partner Risk lens. 'role': partner | competitor | both | oem | software. 'threat': High|Medium|Low = current pressure on Printec's channel (INDEPENDENT of size — a tiny local rival can be High on a specific deal). 'tier': global | regional | local-peer = size/reach class. PRINTEC IS ~€15M EBITDA, so 'local-peer' players (a few €m to low tens of €m, footprint-local) ARE real competition — never omit them, especially in POS/acquiring (the most fragmented segment). Cover the WHOLE size range, not just the giants. 'detect' = lowercased name variants matched in signal text. Update 'latest' + 'threat' + 'tier' each week from Agent 6 findings. Do NOT invent; every 'latest' should trace to a vendor finding (find small/private players via tender winners + local-language press).

vendors.name: NCR Atleos
vendors.latest: Q1 2026: rev $1.043bn +7%, recurring ~72%, Self-Service Banking +~12% with ATMaaS ~+30% YoY (Europe + LatAm expansion); Cashzone now 14 countries (added Colombia 21/05/2026, non-footprint) - no NEW footprint ATMaaS/Cashzone win this window. Established a US reseller collaboration with Sesami for CM-Series Intelligent Teller Cash Recyclers (23/06/2026, US-only - watch for EMEA extension). Brink's acquisition (~$6.6bn) advancing: shareholder votes 30/06/2026, targeted close Q1 2027. Printec's key partner AND a home-market competitor.

vendors.name: Brink's
vendors.latest: Acquiring NCR Atleos for ~$6.6bn (announced 26/02/2026; targeted close Q1 2027): US HSR cleared; both shareholder votes 30/06/2026 ($30 cash + 0.1574 BCO/share); NY proxy suits mooted by voluntary supplemental disclosures (19/06). UK CMA inquiry OPENED 20/05/2026 - invitation-to-comment closed 04/06, but the CMA case page states its formal Phase 1 has NOT yet launched and lists no statutory deadline (the '14 Aug 2026' date is press-reported, NOT confirmed by the regulator); no EU/national filing visible. Holds a minority KAL stake. Brink's Hellas (~3,000 staff) runs CIT + full ATM Managed Services + 'Brink's Complete' intelligent-safe cash-as-a-service in Greece. End-to-end CIT+ATMaaS threat - intensifies if the Atleos deal closes.

vendors.name: Mellon Group
vendors.latest: Coordinated ATM managed-services / pooling alliance: hosted the ATM Innovation & Strategy Forum (Athens, 01/04/2026) with KAL + Brink's (Brink's holds a minority KAL stake since 12/06/2025); themes ATM modernization + ATM pooling. Ingenico POS push: Sales Kick-Off 2026 (Athens 03/03) and 'Next-Gen Payment Acceptance' at the RBI Conference (Vienna 20/04). Mellon Serbia won OTP Bank Serbia QMS (18/02) + ProCredit Bank POS acquiring (12/02). NBG 700 Hyosung Series 8 + KAL deal stands as announced (16/01/2024); no 2026 rollout milestone confirmed. (Mellon Romania Hyosung/KAL is a Nov-2023 item, not a fresh 2026 entry.) Printec's main regional rival on ATM + POS; mellongroup.com/news is JS-only (sitemap 404).

vendors.name: Euronet
vendors.latest: CrediaBank ATM partnership now confirmed at PRIMARY (CrediaBank's own press release, 12/05/2026): 141 CrediaBank ATMs (80 in-branch / 61 off-site) fold into Euronet ATMaaS; CrediaBank customers get fee-free use of 2,500+ Euronet ATMs (marketed as Greece's largest network). Merchant-acquiring acquisition still expected to close Q3 2026 (combined GR acquiring >$22bn/yr, >240k merchants, transfers to epay; A2A wallet integrating IRIS). UniCredit Bank Poland branch cash-recycler deal re-confirmed (Q1 2026 call, 29/04). Q1 2026 EFT Processing rev $295.4m +27%; 56,347 installed ATMs. Operationally dominant Greek ATM operator.

vendors.name: Worldline / Cardlink
vendors.latest: North Star 2030 pruning continues on non-European tails while the Greek/SEE acquiring core is RETAINED: New Zealand sold to Cuscal (finalised 29/05/2026); North America / Cetrel / PaymentIQ already closed; ANZ-Australia 51% still pending (close H2 2026, ACCC). 40:1 reverse share split completed 15/06; ASTERIA employee-shareholding plan (16/06) - recapitalisation wrapping up. New online breadth (Click to Pay for recurring payments, 24/06 - e-commerce only). H1 2026 results 30/07/2026. 'Distressed exit in Greece' thesis stays weakened; owns Cardlink, an aggressive GR POS/SoftPOS rival.

vendors.latest: ATM OEM building referenceable end-to-end managed-ATM (Branch Automation Solutions) wins to sell into SEE: VyStar Credit Union (US, 05/05/2026) selected DN BAS / SMART Managed Services to upgrade 200+ ATMs with DN Series recyclers - adds to FOREX Nordics (~90 ATMs) and the 'Best ATM Services Europe' award. New CIO Raj Singh (18/05) with an AI/GenAI + service-delivery mandate. Where Payten wins ATM outsourcing it standardises on DN hardware (Banca Intesa Serbia Cineo - a 2020 reference). NOTE: the earlier 'PrivatBank could not source DN recycler maintenance / DN service churn' framing is unsourced inference, not confirmed - treat as a hypothesis to test. Q1/Q4 earnings on file (EDGAR).
